stage0089b_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$カイエン$$
「$$アマタ$$, where do you think you're going!?」

stage0089b_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$モロイ$$
「This is bad, $$カイエン$$!
　$$ミコノ$$ and $$ゼシカ$$ went off somewhere alone too!」

stage0089b_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「We don't even know where the Mythical Aquarion is...
　What in the world is happening!?」

stage0089b_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「I wasn't in Altair for nothing!
　I'll find $$ゼシカ$$ and $$ミコノ$$ myself!」

stage0089b_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$アリシア$$
「I've been waiting for you... all this time」

stage0089b_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$アリシア$$
「That's right...
　After I came to Altair, I kept myself asleep
　to protect myself from Eve's curse」

stage0089b_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$アリシア$$
「But then he... woke me up...
　before the final battle」

stage0089b_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$アリシア$$
「$$アマタ$$, I finally get to see you...
　You've grown so much...」

stage0089b_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$アマタ$$
「What now, after all this time...!
　You left me behind...!」

stage0089b_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Do you have any idea what it's been like for me!?
　And now, after all this, you call out to me...!」

stage0089b_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$アリシア$$
「$$アマタ$$...
　I won't ask you to forgive me」

stage0089b_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$アリシア$$
「But please... I want you to know.
　Why I left you behind...
　and about your father...」

stage0089b_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$アリシア$$
「Your father isn't from Earth.
　$$イズモ・カムロギ$$... Supreme Commander of Altair」

stage0089b_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$アリシア$$
「Your father came to our Earth on a mission
　to bring back a woman who could withstand dimensional transfer.
　This was back when I was still an actress」

stage0089b_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$アリシア$$
「I met your father after he made an emergency landing from a system failure.
　And as he spent time with me,
　he realized I was the $$レア・イグラー$$ Altair was looking for...」

stage0089b_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$アリシア$$
「But in even less time than that,
　we fell for each other...」

stage0089b_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$アリシア$$
「Your father hid my existence, at least at first,
　and returned to Altair.
　But he couldn't fool that man $$ミカゲ$$」

stage0089b_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$アリシア$$
「A few years later, when he appeared again,
　you were already there」

stage0089b_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Did that guy try to drag you to Altair
　against your will?」

stage0089b_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Then you decided to go to Altair on your own!
　Even knowing about Eve's curse!」

stage0089b_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$アリシア$$
「I agonized for so long over whether to take you to Altair...
　But my fear of putting you in danger
　on an unknown planet was greater」

stage0089b_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$アリシア$$
「I never imagined it would be such a long parting...」

stage0089b_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$アリシア$$
「No... however I dress it up in words,
　there's no denying I abandoned you」

stage0089b_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$アリシア$$
「I wanted to save the planet of the man I loved.
　The thing he loved most...」

stage0089b_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$アマタ$$
「...I resented you for so long.
　But not anymore...」

stage0089b_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「What I hate is myself back then,
　who could only watch you go...」

stage0089b_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$アマタ$$
「You had the courage to chase after the one you loved,
　and I didn't...
　That's all it comes down to, Mom」

stage0089b_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Let me thank you as well」

stage0089b_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$イズモ$$
「$$アリシア$$...
　I want to meet my end with you」

stage0089b_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I heard about you from Mom」

stage0089b_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$イズモ$$
「...I have no words to ask your forgiveness...
　I took your mother from you... I...」

stage0089b_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Impossible...
　Every natural living creature on Iron-C
　should have died out」

stage0089b_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Kagerou...
　I saw one, just once, when I was young...」

stage0089b_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$イズモ$$
「The females vanished, and they should have gone extinct long ago...
　Why, after all this time...」

stage0089b_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$イズモ$$
「This is Area 337...
　where trouble kept flaring up on Iron-C...
　Don't tell me Iron-C itself is...!」

stage0089b_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Woman and man, yin and yang. Only with both poles
　is the order of all creation maintained... he said」

stage0089b_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Mother Earth, the goddess of the land...
　The land that brings forth abundance is a symbol of womanhood...」

stage0089b_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$イズモ$$
「And Iron-C is a system that draws energy
　from the planet's land...」

stage0089b_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$イズモ$$
「But perhaps, at the same time, it was stealing away
　the planet's maternal power...」

stage0089b_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$アマタ$$
「So that's... the cause of Eve's curse...」

stage0089b_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Iron-C is the root of it all...
　Was my entire life for nothing...」

stage0089b_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Stay with me!
　We just found each other!
　Dad...! Dad!!」

stage0089b_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$アリシア$$
「Your life was never in vain.
　...Kagerou is living with all its might,
　burning its fleeting life to the fullest...」

stage0089b_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$アリシア$$
「That will bring about a miracle.
　Altair will surely be reborn」

stage0089b_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Like that warrior from Vega who overcame fate...?」

stage0089b_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$アリシア$$
「And I'm sure $$アマタ$$ will protect Altair.
　After all, he's our child...
　a bridge connecting our two worlds」

stage0089b_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$アリシア$$
「$$アマタ$$...
　You are the proof of our love...」

stage0089b_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$アリシア$$
「$$アマタ$$, you too, love someone.
　Someone more precious to you than anyone else...」

stage0089b_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Go, $$アマタ$$...
　To you... I entrust the future of both worlds.........」

stage0089b_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I... I came down to Altair, and then...」

stage0089b_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「No...!
　I can't remember what came after!」

stage0089b_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You need not worry about a thing.」

stage0089b_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「This is inside my own heart...
　Yes... you've fallen under my spell.」

stage0089b_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I've been waiting for this moment...」

stage0089b_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Ah... what a marvel, a body of flesh and blood...!」

stage0089b_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
（This isn't right...! That's not my voice!
　Don't tell me... my body...!）

stage0089b_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You are a wonderful vessel of flesh...
　Now, at last, I can fulfill my long dream...!」

stage0089b_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I promised, didn't I?
　That I'd fill the gap in your heart.」

stage0089b_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Now, you need not suffer any longer.」

stage0089b_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I am $$ミカゲ$$... one who dwells in the shadow of love...
　You should be thankful.」

stage0089b_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It's not often a wingless one comes to house the Wings...
　Fufufufufu...! Ahahahahaha!」

stage0089b_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$シュレード$$, let me first offer my congratulations」

stage0089b_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Overcoming the fear of death and grasping life's joy,
　Master $$シュレード$$ has produced 300 Z-Chips.
　Naturally, I'll add these to the squad's stock」

stage0089b_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This reminded me of that once again.
　Z-Chips truly are the very power of life itself」

stage0089b_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Sorry about that!
　Since things are quite hectic right now,
　I'll have D-Trader run on the auto-system!」

stage0089b_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The celebration for the ace pilot will have to wait for next time!」

stage0089b_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then!
　Even in the middle of battle, let's get to it... business, business!」
